sections.title: Credentials not used in any workflow
sections.description: This credential is not used in any workflow. Keeping unused credentials in your instance is an unneeded security risk.
sections.recommendation: Consider deleting these credentials if you no longer need them.

sections.title: Credentials not used in any active workflow
sections.description: These credentials are not used in active workflows. Keeping unused credentials in your instance is an unneeded security risk.
sections.recommendation: Consider deleting these credentials if you no longer need them.

sections.title: Credentials not used in recently executed workflows
sections.description: These credentials are not used in recently executed workflows, i.e. workflows executed in the past 90 days. Keeping unused credentials in your instance is an unneeded security risk.
sections.recommendation: Consider deleting these credentials if you no longer need them.

sections.title: Official risky nodes
sections.description: These nodes are part of n8n's official nodes and may be used to fetch and run any arbitrary code in the host system. This may lead to exploits such as remote code execution.
sections.recommendation: Consider reviewing the parameters in these nodes, replacing them with app nodes where possible, and not loading unneeded node types with the NODES_EXCLUDE environment variable. See: https://docs.n8n.io/hosting/configuration/environment-variables/

sections.title: Community nodes
sections.description: This node is sourced from the n8n community. Community nodes are not vetted by the n8n team and have full access to the host system. See: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/risks
sections.recommendation: Consider reviewing the source code in any community nodes installed in this n8n instance, and uninstalling any community nodes no longer in use.
